text_block_list.text:
The JBC Classic turns out to be a huge
hit, thanks
in no small part to Smart
Falcon's popularity.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is the pinnacle of dirt
racing, the
year-end Tokyo Daishoten.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, a conversation with fans
reaffirms that
the public's attention
come year's end is instead
centered on
the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide to go watch the
Arima Kinen in
preparation for the
Tokyo Daishoten.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
